title: Open Values Lens Patch v0.1
description: A list of corrections to one facts file: changed scores and added options, each with its source. Written by fact repair (workshop/index.html) and applied by app/engine.js mergeLens, which checks the fingerprint first.

op.description: What the change does: correct one score, or add a new option.

code.description: For set-score: the code of the option being corrected.

key.description: For set-score: the criterion whose score changes.

value.description: For set-score: the corrected score, 0 to 100.

entity.description: For add-entity: the new option, with its code, name, brand, scores and provenance, in the same shape as an option in a facts file.

source.description: Where the corrected fact comes from, so whoever applies the change can check it.

asof.description: The date the source says the fact was true.

note.description: A short note on the fact, shown beside the score.

format.description: Always open-values-lens-patch, so a reader knows what the file is.

version.description: The version of this format the file follows.

target.description: The id of the facts file these changes are for.

baseHash.description: The fingerprint of the facts file the changes were made against. A reader warns when it differs from the file they hold, because the changes may no longer fit.

by.description: Whatever name or label the sender typed. It is not checked, so it is not proof of who sent it.

note.description: The sender's reason for the changes, read first by whoever decides whether to apply them.

created.description: When the file was saved, as an ISO date and time.

ops.description: The changes, in the order they were made.
